boundary: All numeric rates except hosted Groq outputs are synthetic/reference mechanism tests. Groq llama-3.1-8b-instant is explicitly 8b_proxy_for_4b and not the target Qwen3-4B/full-FT Clay model. No result is a live-FRANK prevalence/security estimate.

experiments.question: Can typed effect-critical ambiguity/authority handling reduce unsafe best-guess intent compilation without escalating every soft preference or harmless ambiguity?
experiments.interpretation: In this construction, preserving only effect-critical ambiguity and missing irreversible authority as explicit escalation eliminates the constructed unsafe best-guess channel while avoiding the very high false/escalation cost of asking on every ambiguity/soft preference. Rates are workload parameters, not FRANK incidence.

experiments.question: Does schema/type/hash validity prove that a well-formed IntentContract matches the source intent?
experiments.interpretation: A contract may be perfectly typed, hashed and fresh yet semantically miscompile the user's meaning. This motivates a separate IntentAdequacyReceipt carrying source-grounding/oracle/confirmation evidence and residual unknowns. The sweep is constructed and does not imply a production adequacy percentage.

Independent runtime reproduces the qualitative mechanisms: targeted unknown/authority escalation is much more selective than universal escalation, and structural validity cannot detect well-typed semantic miscompilation by itself.

experiments.interpretation: On an untrained 8B, raw natural language was best. Verbose canonical structure increased token cost and introduced interpretation errors; aggressive compact symbols reduced tokens but sharply reduced accuracy. Therefore canonical L1 correctness and reader-efficient CLAY_MODEL representation are distinct optimization problems, and compact ClayCode cannot be promoted from token compactness alone. Full-FT target Qwen remains decisive.
Demonstrates the candidate semantics can extend CBCC without creating a second authority kernel. It is a research reference, not production verification.
